rationale: All three implement the same selected design within the approved map, but claude's pin has only low-severity gaps (unbound wipe fetch --prune, SSH refusal after runtime creation, text-only launcher test) while cursor's breaks install idempotence, silently skips remote branch deletion during wipe, and leaves gh's active account switched after onboarding sign-in, and codex's turns transient network failures into aborted re-onboards and dead agent panes with misleading auth-login advice.
